hero.title:
Let research

latest.title: A public record, not a feed

openRo.title: One object. Six inspectable evidence layers.
openRo.description: Papers, data, code, and discussion remain bound to one stable identity, with source and version intact through every change.

hermes.title: Hermes researches with you
hermes.subtitle: Not an all-purpose assistant — a collaborator that understands context, checks evidence, and respects boundaries.

context.name: Context awareness

evidence.name: Evidence checking
evidence.desc: Separates fact, source, and inference — uncertainty stated explicitly.

approval.desc: High-impact actions come with previewable diffs; R0–R4 sets intervention strength.

trust.title: Open, but trusted.

descriptions.one: Version chains and provenance stay easy to trace.

intake.title: Arrange the evidence set
